name: Bytebeat Drums
description: 16-pad bytebeat drum instrument. Every pad has its own bytebeat/signed/floatbeat formula, level, pan, tune, decay, choke group, one-shot/Hold mode and four macros. MIDI notes 36-51 trigger the pads; the MPC sequencer provides the patterns. Six factory kits and four user kit slots are included. Built for MPC OS 3.10.1+ and desktop VST2 hosts.
author: bokontep
